messages:
Sam P.: quick q — for /v2/generate structured outputs, if an optional field is 'not applicable' should we return the key with `null` or omit the key entirely? SDK behavior differs between languages.
Priya K.: prefer OMIT unless the semantics are explicitly 'value is null'. null should mean 'we attempted to produce a value and it is explicitly null', not just 'absent'.
Sam P.: that makes sense. current JS SDK maps undefined -> omitted, but Python client turns missing -> None on decode which then serializes back as null in some flows. worried about roundtrip producing nulls downstream.
Tomas L.: yeah serializer asymmetry bites. we should standardize in the spec: "optional absent = no key". also add a note for SDKs to not materialize absent -> null when roundtripping.
Sam P.: example to share:
```
// expected
{"name": "widget", "meta": {}} // no "color" key when unknown

// what we see sometimes
{"name": "widget", "meta": {"color": null}} // explicit null
```
Priya K.: +1. action items: (1) update api-specs doc to state 'absent for optional/unknown', (2) add a lint rule in json-schema CI to catch endpoints that return nullable vs omitted inconsistently, (3) update SDK decoding rules.
Tomas L.: I can add an eslint/jsonschema linter rule for the JS client and raise a PR against api-specs. will also add a note in devex guide for language nuances.
deploy-bot: Canary for api-specs update scheduled at 2024-06-05T15:00Z :rocket:
Sam P.: thanks — i'll open a tiny RFC in api-specs with the wording and a test case. also will add a short canary checklist so we can catch any legacy clients that rely on null.
Priya K.: if we need a compatibility mode for customers who expect null, we could gate behind header `X-Redwood-Compat: preserve-null` for a limited rollout. prefer to avoid long-term special casing.
Sam P.: good call. i'll include the header option as a last-resort note in the RFC.
Tomas L.: ping me when the RFC PR is ready and i'll attach the linter and SDK change to the same milestone.
Sam P.: will do. thanks all :tada:
